summary.text: If you are covered under CareShield Life, apply through the AIC eFASS Application Portal using Singpass.

steps.name: Submit your application
steps.text: If you are covered under CareShield Life, submit your application via the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) eServices for Financing Schemes (eFASS) Application Portal using your Singpass.

quotes.text: If you are covered under CareShield Life and wish to claim from CareShield Life, you should submit your application via the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) eServices for Financing Schemes (eFASS) Application Portal using your Singpass.
